issue.title: GitHub project targets fail #gh word argument validation
issue.description: The refresh_docs target builder emits a GitHub workspace as gh:<owner>/<repo>, such as gh:bbugyi200/cash. The #gh xprompt declares gh_ref as a word, and macro word validation rejects the slash, so launch fails with an argument error. Fix location is left to the task owner.

task_type_fields.impact: Documentation refresh agents for remaining GitHub projects fail to launch, including SASE and configured code projects.
task_type_fields.repro: Run refresh_docs for a GitHub project; its generated gh:<owner>/<repo> workspace reaches #gh as the gh_ref argument and is rejected because word arguments exclude slash.

issue.creation_reason: The approved routine change leaves code projects eligible for refresh, but the observed refresh_docs launch fails for GitHub project targets before the agent starts. File this independent launch defect so the allowlist does not conceal it.
